scope: All registered WorkerMill worktrees, all reachable refs in the 24-hour window, all tracked Markdown documentation; node_modules and generated output are not attributed as authored source. Clean worktree comparison detects uncommitted source. Git author dates can survive cherry-picks; committedAt is integration time. This is a saved-state inventory, not a line-by-line correctness certification.
